name: codex-scope-viewer
description: Temporary live hook event history inspector

scripts.dev: vp run build && vp exec electron dist/app --synthetic
scripts.start: vp run build && vp exec electron dist/app
scripts.check:types: vp exec tsc --project tsconfig.json && vp exec tsc --project tsconfig.tools.json
scripts.test: vp run test:unit && vp run test:electron
scripts.test:electron: vp run build && vp exec node scripts/desktop.ts vp exec playwright test
scripts.validate:resources: vp run build && vp exec node scripts/desktop.ts vp exec node scripts/validate-resources.ts
scripts.setup: vp exec install-electron && vp exec playwright install ffmpeg
